61: uint32_t spinlock_acquire(volatile spinlock_t *slock, int32_t timeout)
62: {
63: 	uint32_t flag = arch_int_disable();
64: 
65: #if (CONFIG_CPU_CNT > 1)
66: 	// Note: The core IDs are the full 32 bit (CORE_ID_REGVAL_PRO/CORE_ID_REGVAL_APP) values
67: 	const volatile uint32_t core_id = (uint32_t)portGET_CORE_ID();
68: 	const volatile uint32_t lock_core_id = slock->core_id;
69: 
70: 	if(core_id == lock_core_id)
71: 	{
72: 		slock->count++;
73: 		arch_int_restore(flag);
74: 		return flag;
75: 	}
76: 
77: 	if(lock_core_id != SPINLOCK_CORE_ID_UNINITILIZE 
78: 		&& lock_core_id != 0
79: 		&& lock_core_id != 1
80: 	) {
81: 		BK_ASSERT(0);
82: 		arch_int_restore(flag);
83: 		return flag;
84: 	}
85: 
86: 	arch_atomic_set(( volatile u32 *)&slock->owner);
87: 	arch_fence();
88: 
89: 	slock->core_id = core_id;
90: 	slock->count = 1;
91: 
92: #endif
93: 	arch_int_restore(flag);
94: 
95: 	return flag;
96: }

139:  * verification code:http://192.168.0.6/wangzhilei/bk7236_verification/-/tree/multicore_spinlock
140:  *
141:  * the exclusive operation is the pair of ldrex following by strex: ldrex performs a load of memory
142:  * but also tags the physical address to be monitored for exclusive access by the that core.
143:  * strex performs a conditional store to the memory, succeeding only if the target location is tagged
144:  * as being monitored for exclusive access by that core. this instruction returns non-zero in the
145:  * general-purpose register if the store does not succeed, and a value of 0 if the store is successful
146:  *
147:  * The issue: two cores occupy the exclusive signal, and the other core maybe cannot unlock/strex successfully

153: static inline int __spin_lock(volatile spinlock_t *lock)
154: {
155: 	uint32_t core_id;
156: 	int status = 0;
157: 
158: 	// Note: The core IDs are the full 32 bit (CORE_ID_REGVAL_PRO/CORE_ID_REGVAL_APP) values
159: 	core_id = portGET_CORE_ID();
160: 
161: 	// The caller is already the owner of the lock. Simply increment the nesting count
162: 	if (lock->owner == core_id)
163: 	{
164: 		BK_ASSERT(lock->count > 0 && lock->count < 0xFF);	  // Bad count value implies memory corruption
165: 		lock->count ++;
166: 		return 1;
167: 	}
168: 
169: 	do
170: 	{
171: 		// Note: __LDAEX and __STREXW are CMSIS functions
172: 
173: 		while (__LDAEX(&lock->owner) != SPIN_LOCK_FREE)
174: 		{
175: 			__WFE();
176: 		}
177: 
178: 		BK_ASSERT((core_id == 0) || (core_id  == 1));
179: 
180: 		// lock is free
181: 		status = __STREXW(core_id, &lock->owner); // Try to set
182: 
183: 	} while (status != 0); // retry until lock successfully
184: 
185: 	lock->count ++;
186: 
187: 	return 1;
188: }
189: 
190: static inline int __spin_lock_try(volatile spinlock_t *lock)
191: {
192: 	uint32_t core_id;
193: 	int status = 0;
194: 
195: 	// Note: The core IDs are the full 32 bit (CORE_ID_REGVAL_PRO/CORE_ID_REGVAL_APP) values
196: 	core_id = portGET_CORE_ID();
197: 
198: 	// The caller is already the owner of the lock. Simply increment the nesting count
199: 	if (lock->owner == core_id)
200: 	{
201: 		BK_ASSERT(lock->count > 0 && lock->count < 0xFF);	  // Bad count value implies memory corruption
202: 		lock->count ++;
203: 		return 1;
204: 	}
205: 
206: 	// Note: __LDAEX and __STREXW are CMSIS functions
207: 
208: 	if (__LDAEX(&lock->owner) != SPIN_LOCK_FREE)
209: 	{
210: 		return 0;
211: 	}
212: 
213: 	BK_ASSERT((core_id == 0) || (core_id  == 1));
214: 	// lock is free
215: 	status = __STREXW(core_id, &lock->owner); // Try to set
216: 
217: 	if(status != 0)
218: 	{
219: 		return 0;
220: 	}
221: 
222: 	lock->count ++;
223: 
224: 	return 1;
225: }

238: {
239:     uint32_t core_id;
240: 
241:     core_id = portGET_CORE_ID();
242:     BK_ASSERT(core_id == lock->owner); // This is a lock that we didn't acquire, or the lock is corrupt
243:     BK_ASSERT((lock->count > 0) && (lock->count < 0x100));
244: 
245:     lock->count  --;
246: 
247:     if (!lock->count)
248: 	{
249: 		// If this is the last recursive release of the lock, mark the lock as free
250: 		// Note: __STL, __DSB, __SEV are CMSIS functions.
251: 
252: 		__STL(SPIN_LOCK_FREE, &lock->owner);
253: 		__DSB();
254:  		__SEV();
255:     }
256: }

96: /****************************************************************************
97:  * Name: nx_smp_start
98:  *
99:  * Description:
100:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
101:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion
102:  *   of the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal
103:  *   multitasking, the additional CPUs would be started by calling this
104:  *   function.
105:  *
106:  * Input Parameters:
107:  *   None
108:  *
109:  * Returned Value:
110:  *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
111:  *
112:  * Assumption:
113:  *   Runs before the full initialization sequence has completed.  Runs after
114:  *   all OS facilities are set up, but before multi-tasking has been started.
115:  *
116:  ****************************************************************************/
117: 
118: int nx_smp_start(void)
119: {
120:   int ret;
121:   int cpu;
122: 
123:   /* Flush dcache before start other CPUs. */
124: 
125:   up_flush_dcache_all();
126: 
127:   /* Start all of the other CPUs.  CPU0 is already running. */
128: 
129:   for (cpu = 1; cpu < CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS; cpu++)
130:     {
131:       /* Start the CPU */
132: 
133:       ret = up_cpu_start(cpu);
134:       if (ret < 0)
135:         {
136:           serr("ERROR: Failed to start CPU%d: %d\n", cpu, ret);
137:           return ret;
138:         }
139:     }
140: 
141:   return OK;
142: }
143: 
144: #endif /* CONFIG_SMP */

204:     {

206:         container_of(curr, struct smp_call_data_s, node[cpu]);
207:       FAR struct smp_call_cookie_s *cookie;

212:       spin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_smp_call_lock, flags);

214:       ret = data->func(data->arg);

175:  * Name: spin_lock
176:  *
177:  * Description:
178:  *   If this CPU does not already hold the spinlock, then loop until the
179:  *   spinlock is successfully locked.
180:  *
181:  *   This implementation is non-reentrant and is prone to deadlocks in
182:  *   the case that any logic on the same CPU attempts to take the lock
183:  *   more than once.
184:  *
185:  * Input Parameters:
186:  *   lock - A reference to the spinlock object to lock.
187:  *
188:  * Returned Value:
189:  *   None.  When the function returns, the spinlock was successfully locked
190:  *   by this CPU.
191:  *
192:  * Assumptions:
193:  *   Not running at the interrupt level.
194:  *
195:  ****************************************************************************/
196: 
197: #ifdef CONFIG_SPINLOCK
198: static inline_function void spin_lock(FAR volatile spinlock_t *lock)
199: {
200:   /* Mark that we want to hold lock */
201: 
202:   spinlock_mark_locking(&lock->info);
203: 
204:   /* Notify that we are waiting for a spinlock */
205: 
206:   sched_note_spinlock(lock, NOTE_SPINLOCK_LOCK);
207: 
208:   /* If CONFIG_SCHED_CRITMONITOR_MAXTIME_BUSYWAIT >= 0, count busy-waiting. */
209: 
210:   nxsched_critmon_busywait(true, return_address(0));
211: 
212:   /* Lock without trace note */
213: 
214:   spin_lock_notrace(lock);
215: 
216:   /* Mark the spinlock has been locked */
217: 
218:   spinlock_mark_locked(&lock->info);
219: 
220:   /* Get the lock, end counting busy-waiting */
221: 
222:   nxsched_critmon_busywait(false, return_address(0));
223: 
224:   /* Notify that we have the spinlock */
225: 
226:   sched_note_spinlock(lock, NOTE_SPINLOCK_LOCKED);
227: }
228: #else
229: #  define spin_lock(lock) ((void)(lock))
230: #endif /* CONFIG_SPINLOCK */

232: /****************************************************************************
233:  * Name: spin_trylock_notrace
234:  *
235:  * Description:
236:  *   Try once to lock the spinlock.  Do not wait if the spinlock is already
237:  *   locked.
238:  *
239:  *   This implementation is the same as the above spin_trylock() except that
240:  *   it does not perform instrumentation logic.
241:  *
242:  * Input Parameters:
243:  *   lock - A reference to the spinlock object to lock.
244:  *
245:  * Returned Value:
246:  *   false - Failure, the spinlock was already locked
247:  *   true  - Success, the spinlock was successfully locked
248:  *
249:  * Assumptions:
250:  *   Not running at the interrupt level.
251:  *
252:  ****************************************************************************/
253: 
254: #ifdef CONFIG_SPINLOCK
255: static inline_function noinstrument_function bool
256: spin_trylock_notrace(FAR volatile spinlock_t *lock)
257: {
258: #ifdef CONFIG_TICKET_SPINLOCK
259:   return atomic_cmpxchg_acquire(&lock->next, &lock->owner,
260:                                 atomic_read(&lock->next) + 1);
261: #else /* CONFIG_TICKET_SPINLOCK */
262:   return atomic_xchg_acquire(&lock->lock, 1) != 1;
263: #endif /* CONFIG_TICKET_SPINLOCK */
264: }
265: #else
266: #  define spin_trylock_notrace(lock) ((void)(lock), true)
267: #endif /* CONFIG_SPINLOCK */

271:  *
272:  * Description:

70: static void mbox_clear_errors(void)

72:   uint32_t config = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_CFG);
73:   uint32_t errors = config & MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
74: 
75:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
76:     {
77:       g_stats.write_error++;
78:     }
79: 
80:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
81:     {
82:       g_stats.read_error++;
83:     }
84: 
85:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
86:     {
87:       g_stats.write_full++;
88:     }
89: 
90:   if (errors != 0)
91:     {
92:       putreg32((config & MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
93:     }

96: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
97:                                 uint32_t length)
98: {
99:   if (source != 0)
100:     {
101:       g_stats.bad_source++;
102:       return false;
103:     }
104: 
105:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
106:     {
107:       g_stats.bad_length++;
108:       return false;
109:     }
110: 
111:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
112:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
113:     {
114:       g_stats.bad_address++;

171: {
172:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
173:   unsigned int i;
174: 
175:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
176:     {
177:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
178: 
179:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
180:         {
181:           continue;
182:         }
183: 
184:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
185:         {
186:           oldest = desc;
187:         }
188:     }

193: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
194: {
195:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
196:   int ret;
197: 
198:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
199:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
200:    */
201: 
202:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
203:     {
204:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
205:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
206:       g_processing_order = 0;
207:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
208:         {
209:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
210:           break;
211:         }
212: 
213:       desc->used = false;
214:     }
215: 
216:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
217:     {
218:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
219:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
220:       g_processing_order = 0;
221:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
222:         {
223:           break;
224:         }
225: 
226:       desc->used = false;
227:     }
228: }

230: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
231: {
232:   (void)irq;
233:   (void)context;
234:   (void)arg;
235: 
236:   mbox_clear_errors();
237: 
238:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
239:     {
240:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
241:       uint32_t address;
242:       uint32_t length;
243:       uint8_t source;
244: 
245:       mbox_process_desc();
246:       desc = mbox_alloc_desc();
247:       if (desc == NULL)
248:         {
249:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
250:           break;
251:         }
252: 
253:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
254:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
255:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
256:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
257:         {
258:           continue;
259:         }
260: 
261:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
262:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
263:              sizeof(desc->message));
264:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
265:       desc->used = true;
266:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
267:       mbox_process_desc();
268:     }
269: 
270:   mbox_process_desc();
271: 
272:   return OK;
273: }

296:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))

326:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
327:   g_rx_order = 0;
328:   g_processing_order = 0;
329:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));

331:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
332:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
333:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
334:    */

336:   putreg32(2u | MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |

338:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
339:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
340:   mbox_clear_errors();
341: 
342:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
343:   if (ret < 0)
344:     {
345:       return ret;
346:     }
347: 
348:   g_mbox_ready = true;
349:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
350:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
351:   return OK;

87:   int cpu;
88: 
89:   /* Disable CMCC1 */
90: 
91:   putreg32(0, 0x48018008);
92:   while ((getreg32(0x4801800c) & 0x01) != 0);
93: 
94:   cpu = this_cpu();
95:   DPRINTF("cpu = %d\n", cpu);
96: 
97:   if (cpu == 1)
98:     {
99:       /* Use CPU0 vectors */
100: 
101:       putreg32((uint32_t)_stext, NVIC_VECTAB);
102:       sam_ipc1_enableclk();
103: 
104:       /* Clear : write-only */
105: 
106:       putreg32(0x1, SAM_IPC1_ICCR);
107: 
108:       /* Enable : write-only */
109: 
110:       putreg32(0x1, SAM_IPC1_IECR);
111:       irq_attach(SAM_IRQ_SMP_CALL1, sam4cm_smp_call_handler, NULL);
112:       up_enable_irq(SAM_IRQ_SMP_CALL1);
113:     }
114: 
115:   spin_unlock(&g_cpu1_boot);
116: 
117: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION
118:   /* Notify that this CPU has started */
119: 
120:   sched_note_cpu_started(this_task());
121: #endif
122: 
123:   /* Then transfer control to the IDLE task */
124: 
125:   nx_idle_trampoline();

128: /****************************************************************************
129:  * Name: up_cpu_start
130:  *
131:  * Description:
132:  *   In an SMP configuration, only one CPU is initially active (CPU 0).
133:  *   System initialization occurs on that single thread. At the completion of
134:  *   the initialization of the OS, just before beginning normal multitasking,
135:  *   the additional CPUs would be started by calling this function.
136:  *
137:  *   Each CPU is provided the entry point to its IDLE task when started.  A
138:  *   TCB for each CPU's IDLE task has been initialized and placed in the
139:  *   CPU's g_assignedtasks[cpu] list.  No stack has been allocated or
140:  *   initialized.
141:  *
142:  *   The OS initialization logic calls this function repeatedly until each
143:  *   CPU has been started, 1 through (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).
144:  *
145:  * Input Parameters:
146:  *   cpu - The index of the CPU being started.  This will be a numeric
147:  *         value in the range of one to (CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS-1).
148:  *         (CPU 0 is already active)
149:  *
150:  * Returned Value:
151:  *   Zero on success; a negated errno value on failure.
152:  *
153:  ****************************************************************************/
154: 
155: int up_cpu_start(int cpu)
156: {
157:   struct tcb_s *tcb = current_task(cpu);
158: 
159:   DPRINTF("cpu=%d\n", cpu);
160: 
161:   if (cpu != 1)
162:     {
163:       return -EINVAL;
164:     }
165: 
166: #ifdef CONFIG_SCHED_INSTRUMENTATION
167:   /* Notify of the start event */
168: 
169:   sched_note_cpu_start(this_task(), cpu);
170: #endif
171: 
172:   /* Reset coprocessor */
173: 
174:   putreg32(0x5a000000, SAM_RSTC_CPMR);
175: 
176:   /* Enable Coprocessor Bus Master Clock (write-only) */
177: 
178:   putreg32(PMC_CPKEY | PMC_CPBMCK, SAM_PMC_SCER);
179: 
180:   /* Enable Coprocessor Clock (write-only) */
181: 
182:   putreg32(PMC_CPKEY | PMC_CPCK, SAM_PMC_SCER);
183: 
184:   /* Set Coprocessor Clock Prescalar */
185: 
186:   modifyreg32(SAM_PMC_MCKR, PMC_MCKR_CPPRES_MASK, 0);
187: 
188:   /* Set Coprocessor Clock Source */
189: 
190:   modifyreg32(SAM_PMC_MCKR, PMC_MCKR_CPCSS_MASK, PMC_MCKR_CPCSS_PLLB);
191: 
192:   /* Unreset coprocessor pheripheral */
193: 
194:   putreg32(0x5a000010, SAM_RSTC_CPMR);
195: 
196:   /* Enable clock for SRAM1 where CPU1 starts (write-only) */
197: 
198:   putreg32(PMC_PID42, SAM_PMC_PCER1);
199: 
200:   /* Clear SRAM1 */
201: 
202:   memset((void *)SAM_INTSRAM1_BASE, 0, 16 * 1024);
203: 
204:   /* Copy initial vectors for CPU1 */
205: 
206:   putreg32((uint32_t)tcb->stack_base_ptr +
207:                      tcb->adj_stack_size, CPU1_VECTOR_ISTACK);
208:   putreg32((uint32_t)cpu1_boot, CPU1_VECTOR_RESETV);
209: 
210:   spin_lock(&g_cpu1_boot);
211: 
212:   /* Unreset coprocessor */
213: 
214:   putreg32(0x5a000011, SAM_RSTC_CPMR);
215: 
216:   /* IRQ setup CPU1->CPU0 */
217: 
218:   sam_ipc0_enableclk();
219:   putreg32(0x1, SAM_IPC0_ICCR); /* clear : write-only */
220:   putreg32(0x1, SAM_IPC0_IECR); /* enable : write-only */
221:   irq_attach(SAM_IRQ_SMP_CALL0, sam4cm_smp_call_handler, NULL);
222:   up_enable_irq(SAM_IRQ_SMP_CALL0);
223: 
224:   spin_lock(&g_cpu1_boot);
225: 
226:   /* CPU1 boot done */
227: 
228:   spin_unlock(&g_cpu1_boot);
229: 
230:   return 0;
231: }
232: 
233: #endif /* CONFIG_SMP */

43:  * Description:
44:  *   Allocate a stack for the CPU[n] IDLE task (n > 0) if appropriate and
45:  *   setup up stack-related information in the IDLE task's TCB.  This
46:  *   function is always called before up_cpu_start().  This function is
47:  *   only called for the CPU's initial IDLE task; up_create_task is used for
48:  *   all normal tasks, pthreads, and kernel threads for all CPUs.
49:  *
50:  *   The initial IDLE task is a special case because the CPUs can be started
51:  *   in different wans in different environments:
52:  *
53:  *   1. The CPU may already have been started and waiting in a low power
54:  *      state for up_cpu_start().  In this case, the IDLE thread's stack
55:  *      has already been allocated and is already in use.  Here
56:  *      up_cpu_idlestack() only has to provide information about the
57:  *      already allocated stack.
58:  *
59:  *   2. The CPU may be disabled but started when up_cpu_start() is called.
60:  *      In this case, a new stack will need to be created for the IDLE
61:  *      thread and this function is then equivalent to:
62:  *
63:  *      return up_create_stack(tcb, stack_size, TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL);
64:  *
65:  *   The following TCB fields must be initialized by this function:
66:  *
67:  *   - adj_stack_size: Stack size after adjustment for hardware, processor,
68:  *     etc.  This value is retained only for debug purposes.
69:  *   - stack_alloc_ptr: Pointer to allocated stack
70:  *   - stack_base_ptr: Adjusted stack base pointer after the TLS Data and
71:  *     Arguments has been removed from the stack allocation.
72:  *
73:  * Input Parameters:
74:  *   - cpu:         CPU index that indicates which CPU the IDLE task is
75:  *                  being created for.
76:  *   - tcb:         The TCB of new CPU IDLE task
77:  *   - stack_size:  The requested stack size for the IDLE task.  At least
78:  *                  this much must be allocated.  This should be
79:  *                  CONFIG_SMP_STACK_SIZE.
80:  *
81:  ****************************************************************************/
82: 
83: int up_cpu_idlestack(int cpu, struct tcb_s *tcb, size_t stack_size)
84: {
85: #if CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS > 1
86:   up_create_stack(tcb, stack_size, TCB_FLAG_TTYPE_KERNEL);
87: #endif

530: Make和CMake必须包含同一组SMP源文件，并仅在 `CONFIG_SMP` 下编译专用对象。
531: 
532: ### 6.3 CPU ID
533: 
534: 原厂 AP 使用每核私有 DTCM地址 `0x20000000` 保存 AP逻辑核 ID。OpenVela采用：
535: 
536: ```text
537: 物理CPU1私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU0
538: 物理CPU2私有 0x20000000 = NuttX CPU1
539: ```
540: 
541: `up_cpu_index()` 直接读取该word。primary在任何 per-CPU/NuttX atomic调用前写0；
542: secondary在任何NuttX API前写1。必须实板验证两核看到的是私有实例，不是共享word。
543: 
544: ### 6.4 内存、secondary vector和栈
545: 
546: 分区保持：
547: 
548: ```text
549: AP_SPINLOCK  0x28000000..0x2800ffff
550: AP_RAM       0x28010000..0x28063fff
551: CP_RAM       0x28064000..0x2809f6ff
552: PWR_MNG      0x2809f700..0x2809f7ff
553: SWAP         0x2809f800..0x2809ffff
554: ```
555: 
556: CPU2不增加Flash/RAM分区。链接脚本增加：
557: 
558: - `SPINLOCK` MEMORY，绝不加入heap。
559: - 512字节对齐的 `.bk_secondary_vectors`。
560: - 只用于reset早期的CPU2 bootstrap stack。
561: - 两份静态 interrupt stack，或等价的每核固定中断栈区域。
562: - 全部边界和对齐 `ASSERT`。
563: 
564: secondary vector：
565: 
566: ```text
567: word 0: CPU2 bootstrap MSP top
568: word 1: bk7258_secondary_start | 1
569: ```
570: 
571: CPU2 boot offset寄存器只保存地址高24位，至少要求256字节对齐；统一采用512字节以
572: 满足VTOR约束。secondary vector不包含primary image offset `0x100` 的BK legacy magic。
573: 
574: `up_cpu_idlestack()` 应像RP2040一样调用 `up_create_stack()`，初始化logical CPU1 idle
575: TCB。还必须分配 `CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS * INTSTACK_SIZE` 对齐空间并实现
576: `uintptr_t up_get_intstackbase(int cpu)`；公共ARM实现只覆盖UP构建，ARMv8-M任务初始状态
577: 会调用该hook。CPU2 reset后先用bootstrap MSP；进入NuttX前将PSP切到idle TCB stack
578: top，调用 `arm_initialize_stack()` 安装本核MSP/MSPLIM interrupt stack。两个核不得共用
579: MSP。
580: 
581: ### 6.5 CPU2启动
582: 
583: `up_cpu_start(1)`：
584: 
585: ```text
586: 校验cpu==1且当前为logical CPU0
587:   -> 确认CP的OpenVela CPU2 power-only hold和domain readback均为ON
588:   -> 确认480 MHz契约和channel 2已配置
589:   -> 发布idle PSP、interrupt MSP、runtime VTOR
590:   -> 清boot stage/online flag，DMB/DSB
591:   -> CPU2保持reset时清route/pending
592:   -> CPU2_RXEVT_SEL=1
593:   -> CPU2_OFFSET=secondary_vector>>8
594:   -> cpu2_release_reset()（极性已由run-status/实板验证）
595:   -> 有界等待online和双向IPI自检
596: ```
597: 
598: 超时建议500 ms，输出CPU2 control、run status、route、NVIC、Mailbox channel 2、boot
599: stage和当前频率readback，然后panic。不能只返回错误后继续 `nx_bringup()`。
600: 
601: `bk7258_secondary_start()` 只初始化每核私有状态：
602: 
603: - logical ID、FPU CP10/11和barrier。
604: - 与primary一致的SAU/MPU/VTOR。
605: - CPU2私有NVIC enable/pending/priority。
606: - CPU2 Mailbox route和IRQ79。
607: - PSP/MSP/stack limit。
608: - release-ordered online flag、可选的 `sched_note_cpu_started(this_task())`、
609:   `nx_idle_trampoline()`。
610: 
611: primary以acquire语义等待online flag。`sched_note_cpu_started()`只是可选trace，在note
612: driver未启用时为空，不能承担online handshake。
613: 
614: secondary禁止复制 `.data`、清 `.bss`、初始化heap/PSRAM/driver、调用 `nx_start()`、
615: 初始化第二个SysTick或重置全局Mailbox FIFO。
616: 
617: ### 6.6 每核MPU/NVIC
618: 
619: MPU、SAU、NVIC、VTOR、SysTick和FPU控制均为每核私有。CPU2必须安装与CPU1相同的：
620: 
621: - AP Flash RO/X。
622: - AP RAM RW/XN/shareable。
623: - `AP_SPINLOCK` RW/XN/non-cacheable/shareable。
624: - CP共享窗口和Mailbox UART override。
625: - PSRAM 16 MiB RW/XN/non-cacheable。
626: - peripheral Device/XN。
627: 
628: 当前 CPU1 使用7个 MPU region；增加 AP_SPINLOCK 后至少需要8个，启动时继续读
629: `MPU_TYPE.DREGION`并 fail-stop。CPU2不能重复probe或初始化PSRAM allocator。
630: 
631: 全局NuttX IRQ table只由primary初始化一次。CPU2只初始化私有NVIC和CPU2 route：
632: 
633: ```text
634: CPU1 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010088 / 0x4401008c
635: CPU2 IRQ EN0/EN1: 0x44010090 / 0x44010094
636: ```
637: 
638: 首版只有CPU2 Mailbox IPI路由到CPU2。GPIO、PWM、I2C、QSPI、camera、Wi-Fi和其他
639: 有状态外设仍由logical CPU0 owner。
640: 
641: ## 7. Mailbox IPI与CP transport共存
642: 
643: ### 7.1 物理channel
644: 
645: | channel | owner | FIFO |
646: | ---: | --- | --- |
647: | 0 | CPU0/CP | start 0, length 2 |
648: | 1 | CPU1/AP primary | start 2, length 3 |
649: | 2 | CPU2/AP secondary | start 5, length 3 |
650: 
651: 沿用原厂消息分类：
652: 
653: ```text
654: data[1] != 0: pointer + length envelope，进入CP/AP logical transport
655: data[1] == 0: AP内部raw command，进入SMP IPI handler
656: ```
657: 
658: CPU2不处理CP PWC、heartbeat、Wi-Fi或Mailbox UART envelope。CP transport始终由
659: logical CPU0负责。
660: 
661: ### 7.2 当前初始化路径的改造
662: 
663: 当前 physical Mailbox 已在 `arm_serialinit()` 中经：
664: 
665: ```text
666: bk7258_mailbox_init()
667: bk7258_mb_uart_init()
668: bk7258_mailbox_start()
669: ```
670: 
671: 启动。这发生在 `nx_smp_start()` 之前，生命周期适合SMP。改造要求：
672: 
673: 1. primary physical start一次性配置channel 1和2 FIFO，不能在CPU2 online后soft reset。
674: 2. 全局 `irq_attach(79, ...)` 只执行一次；CPU2复用共享NuttX IRQ handler table，但启用
675:    自己的route和私有NVIC line 63。
676: 3. ISR按 `up_cpu_index()` 选择本核physical channel。
677: 4. channel 1可处理CP envelope和raw IPI；channel 2只接受raw IPI。
678: 5. shared transport状态从仅 `up_irq_save()` 改为SMP spinlock，或严格固定到CPU0。
679: 
680: ### 7.3 NuttX SMP hooks
681: 
682: 实现：
683: 
684: ```c
685: int up_send_smp_sched(int cpu);
686: void up_send_smp_call(cpu_set_t cpuset);
687: ```
688:

751: ## 9. 系统tick、heartbeat与时间正确性
752: 
753: 首版只有logical CPU0启动SysTick。CPU2不得调用 `up_timer_initialize()`，否则系统时间
754: 和RR accounting加倍。CPU0每tick调用NuttX timer处理，调度器通过IPI要求CPU2切换。
755: 
756: 必须满足：
757: 
758: - `CONFIG_SYSTEM_TIME64=y`。
759: - CPU1实际频率和 `CONFIG_BK7258_CPU_FREQ_HZ=480000000` 一致。
760: - 60秒wall clock测试误差在晶振/调度允许范围内，不能出现2倍或1/2倍。
761: - heartbeat实际周期约2秒，不是4秒。
762: - heartbeat发送返回值必须检查并统计 `-EBUSY`、`-ENOLINK`、timeout。
763: - CP heartbeat使用实际 `CONFIG_INT_WDT` 配置；timeout至少容纳调度抖动和一次transport
764:   recovery，但不能用增大timeout掩盖lost heartbeat。
765: 
766: 长期测试必须跨越旧故障边界：至少运行3小时；正式验收运行24小时。还应通过调试构建

21: #define DEFPRIORITY32 \
22:   (NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 24 | \
23:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 16 | \
24:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT << 8  | \
25:    NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT)

27: static inline void bk7258_route_irq(int extirq, bool enable)
28: {
29:   uintptr_t regaddr;
30:   uint32_t bit;
31: 
32:   if (extirq < 32)
33:     {
34:       regaddr = BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0;
35:       bit = 1u << extirq;
36:     }
37:   else
38:     {
39:       regaddr = BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1;
40:       bit = 1u << (extirq - 32);
41:     }
42: 
43:   if (enable)
44:     {
45:       modifyreg32(regaddr, 0, bit);
46:     }
47:   else
48:     {
49:       modifyreg32(regaddr, bit, 0);
50:     }
51: }
52: 
53: static int bk7258_irqinfo(int irq, uintptr_t *regaddr, uint32_t *bit,
54:                           uintptr_t offset)
55: {
56:   int extirq;
57: 
58:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7258_IRQ_NMI && irq < NR_IRQS);
59: 
60:   if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
61:     {
62:       extirq = irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST;
63:       *regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_ENABLE(extirq) + offset;
64:       *bit = 1u << (extirq & 31);
65:       return OK;
66:     }
67: 
68:   *regaddr = NVIC_SYSHCON;
69:   switch (irq)
70:     {
71:       case BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT:
72:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_MEMFAULTENA;
73:         break;
74:       case BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT:
75:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_BUSFAULTENA;
76:         break;
77:       case BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT:
78:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_USGFAULTENA;
79:         break;
80:       case BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT:
81:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_SECUREFAULTENA;
82:         break;
83:       case BK7258_IRQ_SYSTICK:
84:         *regaddr = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL;
85:         *bit = NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL_ENABLE;
86:         break;
87:       default:
88:         return ERROR;
89:     }
90: 
91:   return OK;
92: }
93: 
94: static inline void bk7258_prioritize_svcall(int priority)
95: {
96:   uint32_t regval = getreg32(NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
97:   regval &= ~NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_MASK;
98:   regval |= priority << NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_PR11_SHIFT;
99:   putreg32(regval, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
100: }
101: 
102: void up_irqinitialize(void)
103: {
104:   uintptr_t regaddr;
105:   int priority_registers;
106:   int i;
107: 
108:   for (i = 0; i < BK7258_EXTIRQ_COUNT; i += 32)
109:     {
110:       putreg32(0xffffffffu, NVIC_IRQ_CLEAR(i));
111:     }
112: 
113:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0);
114:   putreg32(0, BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1);
115: 
116:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH4_7_PRIORITY);
117:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH8_11_PRIORITY);
118:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);
119: 
120:   priority_registers = ((getreg32(NVIC_ICTR) & 0x1f) + 1) * 8;
121:   regaddr = NVIC_IRQ0_3_PRIORITY;
122:   while (priority_registers-- > 0)
123:     {
124:       putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, regaddr);
125:       regaddr += 4;
126:     }
127: 
128:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SVCALL, arm_svcall, NULL);
129:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_HARDFAULT, arm_hardfault, NULL);
130:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT, arm_memfault, NULL);
131:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT, arm_busfault, NULL);
132:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT, arm_usagefault, NULL);
133:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT, arm_securefault, NULL);
134:   arm_enable_dbgmonitor();
135:   irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_DBGMONITOR, arm_dbgmonitor, NULL);
136: 
137:   bk7258_prioritize_svcall(NVIC_SYSH_SVCALL_PRIORITY);
138:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT);
139:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_BUSFAULT);
140:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT);
141:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_SECUREFAULT);
142:   up_irq_enable();
143: }
144: 
145: void up_enable_irq(int irq)
146: {
147:   uintptr_t regaddr;
148:   uint32_t regval;
149:   uint32_t bit;
150: 
151:   if (bk7258_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit, 0) == OK)
152:     {
153:       if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
154:         {
155:           bk7258_route_irq(irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST, true);
156:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
157:         }
158:       else
159:         {
160:           regval = getreg32(regaddr);
161:           putreg32(regval | bit, regaddr);
162:         }
163:     }
164: }
165: 
166: void up_disable_irq(int irq)
167: {
168:   uintptr_t regaddr;
169:   uint32_t regval;
170:   uint32_t bit;
171: 
172:   if (bk7258_irqinfo(irq, &regaddr, &bit,
173:                      NVIC_IRQ0_31_CLEAR - NVIC_IRQ0_31_ENABLE) == OK)
174:     {
175:       if (irq >= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
176:         {
177:           putreg32(bit, regaddr);
178:           bk7258_route_irq(irq - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST, false);
179:         }
180:       else
181:         {
182:           regval = getreg32(regaddr);
183:           putreg32(regval & ~bit, regaddr);
184:         }
185:     }
186: }

199:   DEBUGASSERT(irq >= BK7258_IRQ_MEMFAULT && irq < NR_IRQS);
200:   DEBUGASSERT((unsigned int)priority <= NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MIN);
201: 
202:   if (irq < BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)
203:     {
204:       regaddr = NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY(irq);
205:       irq -= 4;
206:     }
207:   else
208:     {
209:       irq -= BK7258_IRQ_FIRST;
210:       regaddr = NVIC_IRQ_PRIORITY(irq);
211:     }
212: 
213:   shift = (irq & 3) << 3;
214:   regval = getreg32(regaddr);
215:   regval &= ~(0xffu << shift);
216:   regval |= (uint32_t)priority << shift;
217:   putreg32(regval, regaddr);

386:

AP子系统

387:
388:

概述

389:

按照新的架构设计, Bk7258支持双核SMP架构, 这两个核共享所有的外设以及内存资源。每个core又各自含有自身的NVIC、cache等私有资源。核间可以通过mailbox交互必要的信息。

390: 396:
397:

备注

398:

1.图中的CPU0/CPU1指的是逻辑core id, 具体解释见下一章节, 后续我们统一用逻辑id来表述。

399:

2.SMP中的mailbox指的是一条物理mailbox通道, 用来给两个内核间传递必要信息。

400:
401:
402:
403:

core id管理

404:

按照新架构的设计, smp系统运行在物理CPU1和CPU2上。

405:

从内核的视角看, 采用的是逻辑id, 即不管实际在什么物理核上, 总是按0、1这样排列;

406:

而从应用层的视角, 由于某些配置的资源需要与具体的物理核绑定, 所以获取到的是物理id。通过os.h文件中的rtos_get_core_id()来得到。该接口返回值为1或者2, 代表物理的CPU1或CPU2。

407:

在SMP启动过程中, 每个core会分别将自身的core id记录到特定位置。

408:
409:

重要

410:

注意: 上层只允许调用rtos_get_core_id()来获取core id,返回值为CPU1_CORE_ID或CPU2_CORE_ID, 对应物理CPU1和CPU2。

411:
412:
413:
414:

SMP启动流程

415:

在系统的引导和初始化阶段, 只有一个上下文, 只能由一个处理器来处理。

416:

所以对于SMP系统, 一般会有一个先启动的core(称为primary core), 由其负责初始化整个系统的资源, 而其他的core则等待这些资源准备好后再开始工作。

417:

对于新的SMP架构,primary core为Core 0(注意此处指的是逻辑ID),由Core 0负责引导这个系统的资源, 如各种外设、memory等。

418:

Core 0在资源引导完毕后, 会释放Core 1,让Core 1开始启动, 之后开始进行系统的任务调度, 整个系统在此时就运行起来了。

419: 425:
426:
427:

SMP编程注意事项

428:

从软件的时间看, SMP系统与单CPU系统在编程上还是有一些差异的。这些差异主要体现在:

429:
    430:

  • 虽然外设与内存资源都是共享的, 但是如果多个CPU同时对共享资源进行访问时, 需要加临界区保护。并且此时传统的关中断方式已经不足以起到临界保护作用, 需要采用关中断 431: 加自旋锁的方式。具体可以参考：SMP 临界区使用

    • 432:

  • 每个core都有自身的中断管理器, 但外设的中断通常是由某一个core来进行处理。需要根据实际需求配置中断路由。 433: 具体可以参考： 中断管理

    • 434:

  • 上层创建的任务可以绑定到SMP系统的某个CPU, 也可以不绑定核, 由内核自行管理。在不绑定核的情形下, 需要注意对访问资源的独占保护。 435: 创建任务的API可以参考: OS适配层API

以下结论来自只读搜索 `/home/mi/vela_competition`，未访问目录树外路径，未修改任何文件。

## 一、结论摘要

1. **BK7258 已有可复用的双核 AP FreeRTOS SMP 基线**，以 `bk_avdk_smp/ap` 最有参考价值：
   - SoC 物理 `CPU1 + CPU2` 组成 AP SMP。
   - FreeRTOS 逻辑核 `0/1` 分别对应物理 `CPU1/CPU2`。
   - 物理 CPU2 由 CPU1 写 boot offset、配置 RXEVT、释放 reset。
   - CPU ID 放在每核私有 DTCM 地址 `0x20000000`。
   - MBOX0 channel 1/2 分别归物理 CPU1/CPU2，raw mailbox command 用作跨核 yield/IPI。
   - 每核独立 VTOR、NVIC、MSP/MSPLIM。
   - spinlock 使用 `LDAEX/STREX`、`WFE/SEV`，并要求锁门变量位于专用 `AP_SPINLOCK` SRAM。

2. **最重要的 reset 极性结论**：
   - 实际启动/停止调用链一致表明：`CPU2_SW_RST=1` 是 **release reset / 开始运行**，`CPU2_SW_RST=0` 是 **hold reset / 停止运行**。
   - 但 HAL 中存在完全相反的注释“1:reset; 0:not reset”。
   - 因此该位虽然名为 `sw_rst`，在现有 BK7258 启动代码中的操作语义实际上更接近 **active-high reset release/run-enable**。
   - 源码证据很强，但目录树内没有实板寄存器 trace 可以消除全部歧义；正式移植仍应以 `CPU_CURRENT_RUN_STATUS` 和 CPU2 online 行为做一次实板确认。

3. **contest 当前 BK7258 NuttX 仍是单核**：
   - `CONFIG_UP=1`、`CONFIG_SMP_NCPUS=1`。
   - BK7258 Kconfig 未选择 `ARCH_HAVE_MULTICPU`。
   - 没有 `up_cpu_start()`、`up_cpu_index()`、`up_send_smp_sched()`、`up_send_smp_call()`、CPU2 secondary vector 或每核 interrupt stack 实现。
   - 当前 mailbox 只完整初始化 CPU1 的 channel 1；channel 2 仅用于检查目标 FIFO 状态，尚不是 CPU2 接收/IPI 通道。

4. **当前 contest/openvela NuttX 中没有可直接复用的 ARMv8-M SMP port**：
   - `/arch/arm/src/armv8-m` 没有 cpustart、cpuindex、cpuidlestack、smpcall 文件。
   - Cortex-M33 的 MPS AN521/AN524 也没有选择 `ARCH_HAVE_MULTICPU`。
   - 可借鉴的是其他 ARM M-profile SMP port：RP2040、SAM4CM、CXD56xx、LC823450；其中 RP2040 的 secondary vector/每核栈最接近，SAM4CM 的 IPC IPI 最直接，CXD56xx/LC823450 提供 SWINT/IPI 和 atomic gate 范式。

---

# 二、BK7258 AP SMP 的核映射

厂商文档明确说明物理核和逻辑核的关系：

- 物理 CPU0：CP 单核系统。
- 物理 CPU1、CPU2：组成 AP SMP。
- 内核逻辑核为 0、1。
- 应用层 `rtos_get_core_id()` 返回物理 ID 1、2。

证据：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/博通网页文档/AP(SMP)+CP 架构 — 博通集成 ARMINO SMP开发框架 文档.html:124-125`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/博通网页文档/AP(SMP)+CP 架构 — 博通集成 ARMINO SMP开发框架 文档.html:389-410`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/博通网页文档/AP(SMP)+CP 架构 — 博通集成 ARMINO SMP开发框架 文档.html:415-418`

特别是：

- 物理 CPU1 + CPU2 组成 SMP。
- 内核用逻辑 ID 0、1。
- `rtos_get_core_id()` 对外返回物理 ID 1、2。
- primary 是逻辑 Core 0，即物理 CPU1。
- secondary 是逻辑 Core 1，即物理 CPU2。

AVDK AP 配置也证实这是二核 AP，而不是三核 SMP：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap.defconfig:13-23`
  - `CONFIG_CPU_CNT=2`
  - `CONFIG_SOC_SMP=y`
  - 启用专用 spinlock section。
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/config/sdkconfig.h:7-11`
  - `CONFIG_CPU_CNT=2`
  - `CONFIG_SOC_SMP=1`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/config/sdkconfig.h:343-346`
  - `CONFIG_SPINLOCK=1`
  - `CONFIG_SPINLOCK_SECTION=1`

## AVDK 中容易误解的命名

AVDK 的 `startup_cpu0.c`、`startup_cpu1.c` 使用的是 **AP/FreeRTOS 逻辑核编号**：

- `startup_cpu0.c`：逻辑 CPU0，实际运行在物理 CPU1。
- `startup_cpu1.c`：逻辑 CPU1，实际运行在物理 CPU2。
- `startup_cpu2.c`：为三逻辑核通用代码保留；BK7258 AP 的 `CONFIG_CPU_CNT=2` 正常路径不使用它。

最直接证据是：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu1.c:259-266`

其中 `multicore_launch_core1()` 并不是操作 SoC 的 CPU1 reset，而是调用：

- `reset_cpu2_core(&__vector_core1_table, 1)`

即：

- FreeRTOS logical core 1
- 使用 `.vectors_core1`
- 实际由物理 CPU2 reset/boot 控制寄存器启动

# 三、CPU2 start/reset/vector 和寄存器语义

## 3.1 SYSCTRL 寄存器地址

| 位 | 字段 | 现有代码中的语义 |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `CPU2_SW_RST` | `1` 释放 reset/开始运行；`0` 保持 reset |
| 1 | `CPU2_PWR_DW` | `1` power-down；启动前写 `0` |

| 4 | `CPU2_SPEED` | CPU2 speed 档位 |

# 四、reset 极性的直接证据和冲突

## 4.1 支持“1=release，0=hold”的强证据

### 驱动层明确注释

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_ps_driver.c:91-96`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_ps_driver.c:114-119`

注释明确写：

- `1: reset release, means cpu2 start to run`
- `0: reset means cpu1 at reset status`

第二句把 CPU2 误写成 CPU1，但上下文是 `sys_drv_set_cpu2_reset()`，语义仍明确。

IDK 中同样存在：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/middleware/driver/sys_ctrl/sys_ps_driver.c:121-125`

### start/stop 调用链

AVDK AP：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:205-228`

`reset_cpu2_core()` 顺序：

1. `sys_drv_set_cpu2_pwr_dw(0)`
2. `sys_drv_set_cpu2_rxevt_sel(1)`
3. `sys_drv_set_cpu2_boot_address_offset(offset >> 8)`
4. `sys_drv_set_cpu2_reset(start_flag)`

调用者：

- `start_cpu2_core()` 传 `start_flag=1`
- `stop_cpu2_core()` 传 `start_flag=0`

FreeRTOS SMP 的实际 secondary launch：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu1.c:259-266`

它写入 secondary vector 并传 `1`，随后 CPU2 能进入 `Reset_Handler_Cpu1()`。因此从实际控制流看，`1` 必然是释放/运行语义。

IDK 也一致：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:211-233`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu2.c:250-279`

## 4.2 相反注释

HAL 中写了相反的注释：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/hal/sys_hal.c:298-307`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/middleware/soc/bk7258/hal/sys_hal.c:317-326`

注释是：

- `1:reset ; 0:not reset`

但函数本身只是把参数原样写进 bit0，且与所有实际 start/stop 调用相矛盾。

## 4.3 应采用的结论

源码中最有力、能够形成完整执行链的证据是：

- `start(..., 1)` 后 secondary 进入 Reset Handler。
- `stop(..., 0)` 用于停止/保持 reset。
- 驱动层明确标为 `reset release`。

所以 BK7258 AP 移植中的语义应记录为：

- **写 0：assert/hold CPU2 reset**
- **写 1：deassert/release CPU2 reset，CPU2 从 boot vector 启动**

不应直接把字段名 `CPU2_SW_RST` 解释成传统的 active-high reset assert。建议语义化命名应是“hold/release”，而不是直接暴露 `set_reset(0/1)`。

目录树内没有实板 run-status trace，最终仍应验证：

- hold 时 `0x4401000c` bit6 的读值。
- release 后 bit6 的变化。
- CPU2 是否从配置的 vector word 1 执行。
- CPU2 online flag 是否可稳定建立。

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/arch/arm/src/armv8-m/arm_initialstate.c:182-242`

`arm_initialize_stack()` 的语义：

1. 调用 `up_get_intstackbase(this_cpu())`。
2. 算出本核 interrupt stack top。
3. 若当前仍使用 MSP：
   - 把旧 MSP 复制到 PSP。
   - 必要时把 MSPLIM 复制到 PSPLIM。
   - 设置 `CONTROL.SPSEL`，线程模式改用 PSP。
4. 把本核 interrupt stack top 写入 MSP。
5. 启用硬件 stack check 时，把本核 interrupt stack base 写入 MSPLIM。

因此 CPU2 的 boot vector word 0 只需要提供 **reset/bootstrap MSP**；进入 NuttX secondary 路径后，任务线程应切到 idle TCB 的 PSP，并用 `arm_initialize_stack()` 安装独立的 interrupt MSP/MSPLIM。

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/sched/Kconfig:404-429`
- `CONFIG_SMP` 依赖 `ARCH_HAVE_MULTICPU`
- `CONFIG_SMP` 依赖 `ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK != 0`
- `CONFIG_SMP` 自动选择 `SPINLOCK`

这里“只有 CPU0 可全局初始化”是厂商 logical/physical 代码中的历史命名；移植时应确认究竟由 CP 还是 AP primary 拥有全局配置。contest 当前已经由 AP primary 配置 channel 1，因此 NuttX SMP 方案应保证全局 soft reset/FIFO 配置只执行一次，不能在 CPU2 online 后重新 reset 整个 MBOX0。

## 9.1 IRQ 号和 route

厂商 ICU 映射：

- CPU1 EN0：`0x44010088`

- CPU2 EN1：`0x44010094`

- `up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX)`

当前通用 `up_enable_irq()` 同样把所有外部 IRQ 硬编码路由到 CPU1：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_irq.c:27-51`

## 9.2 AVDK FreeRTOS raw IPI

物理 mailbox driver把消息分两类：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_drv.c:35-77`

语义：

- `data[1] != 0`：普通 pointer+length mailbox envelope。
- `data[1] == 0`：SMP raw command，调用 `crosscore_smp_cmd_handler()`。

raw command 入口：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/mailbox/mbox0_cross_core.c:20-45`

FreeRTOS port 的 pending command 和 yield：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/os_source/freertos_smp_v2p0/FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/GCC/ARM_CM33_NTZ/non_secure/port.c:1011-1120`

关键函数：

- `crosscore_int_send()`
- `crosscore_mb_rx_isr()`
- `crosscore_int_send_yield()`

机制：

1. 在共享 `crosscore_mb_cmd[]` 中设置 command bit。
2. `crosscore_mb_busy[]` 合并重复 kick。
3. 用 mailbox 向目标物理核发送两字 raw 消息。
4. 目标 ISR 清 pending/busy。
5. `CC_YIELD_CORE` 调用本地 `portYIELD_FROM_ISR(true)`，置本核 PendSV。

逻辑到物理目标转换：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/os_source/freertos_smp_v2p0/FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/GCC/ARM_CM33_NTZ/non_secure/port.c:1176-1191`

`vPortYieldCore(logical_id)` 调用：

- `crosscore_int_send_yield(logical_id + 1)`

因此：

- logical 0 → physical mailbox destination 1
- logical 1 → physical mailbox destination 2

## 9.3 可复用但不能照搬的部分

可复用：

- channel 1/2 的物理寄存器与 FIFO 分区。
- `data[1]==0` 作为 raw IPI/kick。
- shared pending bitmap + mailbox kick 的合并思路。
- channel 1/2 与物理核绑定。
- 发送前/接收后 barrier。
- 目标 channel FIFO full 检查。

不能照搬：

- FreeRTOS 的 `portYIELD_FROM_ISR()` 不对应 NuttX 调度模型。
- AVDK 启动只做固定延时，没有可靠 CPU2 online handshake：
  - `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/os_source/freertos_smp_v2p0/FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/GCC/ARM_CM33_NTZ/non_secure/port.c:1210-1222`

- 全局 IRQ handler table 在 NuttX 中只能由 primary 初始化一次。
- AVDK ISR callback 是无参数 callback；当前 NuttX IRQ handler 是三参数形式。

当前 NuttX ISR 类型：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/irq.h:190-193`

# 十一、Spinlock 和 atomic

## 11.1 AVDK vendor spinlock

接口和数据结构：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/spinlock/spinlock.h`

`spinlock_t` 包含：

- `owner`
- `count`
- `core_id`
- 可选 debug owner

关键提示：

- lock 必须位于 shared memory。
- `SPINLOCK_SECTION` 放入 `.sram_spinlock_section`。
- 厂商 spinlock 是递归锁；NuttX 普通 `spinlock_t` 是非递归锁，语义不同。

实现：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/spinlock/spinlock.c:136-270`

关键指令和语义：

- acquire：
  - `__LDAEX(&owner)`
  - busy 时 `__WFE()`
  - `__STREXW(core_id, &owner)`
- release：
  - `__STL(SPIN_LOCK_FREE, &owner)`
  - `__DSB()`
  - `__SEV()`

两核限制：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/spinlock/spinlock.c:136-150`

代码明确禁止 `CONFIG_CPU_CNT > 2` 的 SMP，注释说明 BK7236/BK7258 三个硬件核只有两个 exclusive access monitor，三方并发会导致失败。

专用 SRAM 原因：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/spinlock/spinlock.c:272-285`

注释明确指出：

- SRAM port 上只有两个 exclusive monitor。
- 两 CPU 同时 exclusive access 时，DMA/Audio 等第三方写 SRAM 可能无提示失败。
- spinlock 因而应放在专用 section，避免与普通 DMA 数据冲突。

专用物理区域：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/ram_regions.h:6-9`

地址：

- `AP_SPINLOCK = 0x28000000..0x2800ffff`
- `AP_RAM = 0x28010000..0x28063fff`

Linker：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:45-68`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:428-443`

`.sram_spinlock_section` 被放到独立 `SPINLOCK` MEMORY，不进入 AP heap。

## 11.2 AVDK atomic helper

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/arch/cm33/arm.c:48-93`

关键函数：

- `arch_atomic_set()`

语义：

类型：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/spinlock_type.h:80-109`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/spinlock_type.h:80-109`

算法：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/spinlock.h:138-168`

## 11.4 当前 contest 配置的 atomic 不是 SMP 可用结论

当前最终配置：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/out/beken_bk7258-ap_nsh/include/nuttx/config.h:216`
- `CONFIG_LIBC_ATOMIC_TOOLCHAIN=1`

这是当前 UP 构建可以接受的配置，但不等于符合 BK7258 SMP 的 exclusive 约束。工具链可能在每一个普通 atomic object 地址上生成 exclusive loop，而这些对象遍布 `.bss`、heap 和驱动对象，并不都在 `AP_SPINLOCK` 区域。

NuttX atomic backend选择：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/libs/libc/machine/Kconfig:12-35`

选项：

- `LIBC_ATOMIC_ARCH`
- `LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK`
- `LIBC_ATOMIC_IRQ`
- `LIBC_ATOMIC_TOOLCHAIN`

NuttX 已有“单一硬件 gate 保护所有 atomic”的公共后端：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/libs/libc/machine/arch_atomic.c:324-345`

当选择 `CONFIG_LIBC_ATOMIC_HWSPINLOCK` 时，它通过：

- `g_atomic_hwspinlock`
- `hwspin_lock_irqsave()`
- 普通 load/store/RMW
- `hwspin_unlock_restore()`

完成所有 atomic。

接口定义：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/hwspinlock/hwspinlock.h:38-113`

现有 ARM 参考：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/rp2040/rp2040_atomic.c`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/cxd56xx/cxd56_atomic.c`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/nuttx/arch/arm/src/lc823450/lc823450_atomic.c`

这三个文件都定义 `g_atomic_hwspinlock`，把 libc atomic 串行化到芯片级 lock。

对 BK7258 的直接含义是：

- 不能只打开 `CONFIG_SMP` 并继续使用当前无约束的 toolchain atomic。
- 最吻合厂商限制的复用方向，是让所有 NuttX atomic 通过一个位于 `0x28000000..0x2800ffff` 的 approved gate 串行化，然后在 gate 内对目标对象做普通 RMW。
- 目录树中目前没有 BK7258 对应的 `g_atomic_hwspinlock` 或 arch atomic backend。
